caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame with light grayish-blue color and decorative scrollwork at the top corners. At the top edge of the frame, there are several renderings of fruits and vegetables in muted greenish and gray tones, including what appear to be cucumbers, squash, and possibly a bundle of corn. Within the frame, there is a large, central, brown wooden tool forming a triangular “A” shape, with the inscription "H. I. Welton" on the horizontal crossbar. Suspended inside the frame and arranged in an orderly manner are several agricultural tools: two wooden-handled sickles with curved blades and attached chains, a dark-colored scythe, and a brown wooden plow with a metal blade attached at the lower left. The background is an unadorned beige or off-white, allowing the depicted objects to stand out clearly.
title: Gate
